purpose: Fix noisy Commons searches by requiring precise Place > physical sacred subject > exact photo target > identity verification; no new pin identities.
invariants: Do not treat site cover, generic shrine images or broad saint searches as pictures of an exact subject.
A pictured 1960 marble group, 2016 mosaic, 1884 replica, original gable, grotto, spring and 1436 reliquary are distinct material subjects.
No under-review or unpublished relic photo may render in the live application.
Sourced guide stops sometimes lie offsite: do not mint a pin, infer same interior, or enable their photo search without physical containment review.
Apparitions are event accounts, not photographable historical events; only independently documented present-day markers or artworks can be photographed.
For a selected relic, do not assume the photograph shows the relic rather than only its container; caption exactly what is visible.
Every Commons candidate is a proposal; photograph license, author, underlying artwork rights, bytes, image identity, date and accuracy require separate checks.
All original user-selected Place covers and their editorial status remain untouched.
